dict.string: Hydra listens when you talk to it, and listens for a double clap while it sleeps.
Hydra turns what you say into text, on your Mac.
Hydra reads files on your Desktop when you ask it to.
Hydra reads files in Documents when you ask it to.
Hydra reads files in Downloads when you ask it to.
Hydra looks at your screen when you ask it to.
